text:
Type: textured chevron area rug
Use: anchoring a living or dining area; living room, dining room, bedroom
Style: contemporary, modern, minimalist
Materials: soft cut and loop pile, carved texture
Colors: cool medium grey, light grey
Shape: oversized rectangle, tone-on-tone herringbone chevron rows in raised pile, plush texture, solid calm presence
Feel: soft, calm, cozy
Goes with: warm wood, white walls, green plants, wood chairs; modern or mid-century rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Contemporary Chevron Rug, 13' x 9' 6", Grey
product.description: This modern rug brings sophistication to any room with its graceful interlocked chevron pattern. Low- and high-pile loops are combined to create a three-dimensional look and feel. The durable fabric is ready for high-traffic areas. 13' x 9' 6" High-low medium pile is easy to clean Pair with rug pad (sold separately) Ships tightly rolled in a protective bag
